purpose: Compare fixed and resampled HAC scales; diagnose finite-sample error without tuning to evaluation outcomes.

data_generating_processes.gaussian_ar: Stationary AR(1) with marginal sigma, Gaussian equicorrelated shocks and exact stationary initial state; all null means zero.
data_generating_processes.student_ar: AR(1) with sqrt(rho)*u+sqrt(1-rho)*v shocks; each u/v is an independent standardized Student t5 draw (variance one); marginal returns are not exactly t5; initialize zero and discard 512 observations.
data_generating_processes.garch: phi=0; alpha=0.06, beta=0.90, omega=(1-alpha-beta)*sigma^2; same standardized t5 mixture shocks; initialize h=sigma^2 and discard 512 observations.
data_generating_processes.implementation: src/strategy_inference/simulations.py; source hash recorded with each run

tests.fixed: max_j(centered bootstrap mean_j / original HAC standard_error_j)
tests.resampled: max_j(centered bootstrap mean_j / bootstrap HAC standard_error_j); re-center each draw when estimating its HAC; original and bootstrap use the same lags and divisor T
tests.resampling: Shared circular row indices, independent geometric restarts of probability 1/block_length, uniform starts, first row always a restart
tests.pvalue: (1 + count(bootstrap maximum >= observed maximum))/(B+1); reject when pvalue <= alpha
tests.oracle: Gaussian only: max_j(mean_j / sqrt(known finite-T mean variance)); known-correlation Gaussian maximum critical value from common-factor one-dimensional quadrature. Does not use observed HAC t.

figure_3.signal_definition: mean[0] = delta * known long-run standard deviation / sqrt(T)

block_sensitivity.length_rule: min(T, max(1, default_block_length(T) * multiplier)); keep fractional expected lengths; no extra rounding

assessment.cells: All zero-mean main and holdout cells; exclude block-sensitivity experiments and positive-mean power cells.
assessment.bound: One-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bounds with Bonferroni adjustment over the 19 prespecified assessment cells.
assessment.policy: Passing is limited evidence for this finite benchmark, not general calibration. Failure is reported without changing settings or discarding cells. Quick never qualifies.

diagnostics: median original HAC variance / finite-T true variance
median exact conditional bootstrap mean variance / finite-T true variance
pairing: The two bootstrap methods share all row draws, data and observed HAC statistics. Nested candidate sets reuse the same maximum-K draws. Power shifts reuse centered draws, every resampled HAC scale, and original standard errors; translation leaves these quantities unchanged.
seed_addresses: SeedSequence(root, spawn_key=(study, scenario, replicate, purpose)); study=11/12/13/14/15 for dependence/selection/processes/holdout/sensitivity, purpose=0 for data and 1 for shared bootstrap rows.
claim_limit: Gaussian known-covariance tests are simulation references; the real-data API never receives true phi, sigma or covariance. No assertion of second-order correctness, universal nominal size or novel theory.
